caption:
The visa document most people skip: the cover letter.

It is not on the checklist, so people leave it out — and hand the officer a pile of documents with no story connecting them.

The cover letter answers what the form cannot: who you are, why this trip, why these dates, who is paying, and what you are returning to in the UAE. It turns a stack of paper into a case.
